verdict.rationale: cfo.ai's own docs show built-in recurring automation. Data connections refresh nightly and the user can change that refresh time. Ari keeps the Model current and messages proactively when numbers move. Pricing lists 'Proactive alerts & triggers', and one example is a board deck drafted off last night's numbers. There is no evidence that users can define their own recurring jobs or workflows with custom cadences. missing for 10: user-defined scheduled workflows/jobs with arbitrary cadence, documentation of how triggers are configured, scheduling via MCP/agent tools, independent or hands-on corroboration.
